## **Universal Phase-by-Phase Implementation and Verification Guide (Phases 01 to 32\)**

The Phase 1 pattern—combining 60% pre-baked POSIX/Git infrastructure, 30% ICM folder topology and Pydantic v2 FastMCP validation, and 10% GPU inference—scales uniformly across all 32 phases of Hermes Agent OS1. On the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU (GA107, 2048 CUDA Cores, 64 Tensor Cores, 128-bit bus with 192.0 GB/s theoretical GDDR6 bandwidth), non-speculative generation over the 2.70 GB gemma-4-E4B\_q4\_0-it.gguf model is physically memory-bandwidth-bound at ![][image42] (with unoptimized base inference measured at 25.6 tok/s and MTP-only draft speculation reaching 62.0–78.0 tok/s)1. By cascading Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) with N-gram lookup drafting (--spec-type draft-mtp,ngram-map-k \--spec-draft-n-max 3 \--spec-draft-p-min 0.72) and CUDA graph fusion (GGML\_CUDA\_GRAPH\_OPT=1), Port 8138 verifies up to 3 candidate tokens per forward pass at an empirical draft acceptance rate of 58.70% (81 / 138 draft tokens accepted during cold generation) to 62.12% (82 / 132 draft tokens accepted during cached multi-turn generation)1. Consequently, live generation speed surges past the physical single-token bandwidth limit to 91.33 tok/s (10.95 ms/tok, 1,401.58 ms for 128 tokens) on cold runs and 98.92 tok/s (10.11 ms/tok, 1,294.03 ms for 128 tokens, peaking at 112.05 tok/s) on cached runs, while prompt evaluation accelerates from 95.04 tok/s (10.52 ms/tok, 389.32 ms for 37 cold tokens) to 748.16 tok/s (1.34 ms/tok, 77.52 ms for 58 new tokens with 32 cached prefix tokens reused)1.

| Speculative Inference Regime / Certified Phase Metric | Measured Throughput / Value | Hardware / Algorithmic Benchmark Threshold | Empirical Telemetry Details |

| **Physical GDDR6 Memory Bandwidth Limit (192.0 GB/s)** | 71.10 tok/s | Theoretical 1-token ceiling | ![][image43] primary GGUF weights1 |
| **MTP Draft Speculation Only (draft-mtp)** | 62.00 – 78.00 tok/s | ![][image44] required | 4-layer mtp-gemma-4-E4B-it-Q4\_0.gguf (420 MiB)1 |
| **Cascaded MTP \+ N-Gram Cold Generation** | **91.33 tok/s** (10.95 ms/tok) | ![][image44] target | 58.70% draft acceptance (81 / 138 tokens, 0 cache reuse)1 |
| **Cascaded MTP \+ N-Gram Cached Multi-Turn Generation** | **98.92 tok/s** (10.11 ms/tok) | Peak 112.05 tok/s (3.8x–4.8x) | 62.12% draft acceptance (82 / 132 tokens, 32 tokens cached)1 |
| **Cold Prompt Evaluation (prompt\_n \= 37\)** | **95.04 tok/s** (10.52 ms/tok) | 389.32 ms total eval time | Initial turn prefill without slot prefix hit1 |
| **Cached Multi-Turn Prompt Eval (prompt\_n \= 58, cache\_n \= 32\)** | **748.16 tok/s** (1.34 ms/tok) | 77.52 ms total eval time | 7.87x prefill speedup via \--keep 4096 slot save1 |
